messages:
alex_support: Customer BrightCart hit a big surge around 08:11 UTC and got repeated 429s + elevated latencies. They say their Dedicated pool stayed at 2 replicas (min_replicas=2) and we didn't scale to handle the spike. Logs attached by customer: 

katie_cs: forwarding their repro and logs, customer says traffic spiked ~3x for ~4 minutes and they saw attach_timeouts + probe failures.

alex_support: pasted the most relevant lines from their agent: 
```
2026-03-17T08:11:12Z INFO probe: start warmchain probe id=abc123 target=dedicated-pool-14
2026-03-17T08:11:15Z WARN attach: imagepull backoff duration=24s err="pull rate limited"
2026-03-17T08:11:36Z ERROR attach: attach timeout after 30s pod=dc-attach-7f
2026-03-17T08:11:40Z WARN autoscaler: probe_timeout threshold=15s probes_inflight=12
2026-03-17T08:11:42Z INFO autoscaler: decided no-scale reason="attach_throttled" min_replicas=2 max_replicas=20
```

maya_oncall: ack. First glance: looks like two compounding issues — registry/imagepull throttling delaying new node/pod readiness (attach) and probe timeouts causing autoscaler to refrain from scaling because probes are failing or queued.

ryan_eng-runtime: pinging in. Can you share the customer's dedicated config and the autoscaler policy? Also any IAM rotation or image registry auth events around that time? Those can block attach.

katie_cs: customer config snippet they provided: 
```json
{"pool":"dedicated-pool-14","min_replicas":2,"max_replicas":20,"warm_probe_timeout_s":15,"attach_timeout_s":30}
```
They also noted they rotated their container registry keys ~08:09 but said rotation finished before surge.

samir_ops-bot: metrics dump (short) from our side around 08:10-08:14: 
- attach_attempts: 17
- attach_timeouts: 6
- probe_timeouts: 9
- registry_401s: 3
- registry_429s(rate-limited): 11
- active_replicas: 2
- queued_scale_requests: 3

ryan_eng-runtime: those registry_429s are the smoking gun. If image pulls are rate-limited, pods stay in ContainerCreating and probes never succeed; autoscaler sees unready pods and because we gate scale decisions when attach is throttled we currently hold to min_replicas to avoid flapping. That gating logic is intended to prevent waste but in this case it's increasing customer latency.

maya_oncall: agreed. Short-term mitigation: increase min_replicas to 6 for the pool while customer tests, or enable prewarmed slots. Also we can temporarily relax the "attach_throttled" veto for that pool. Which do you want to try?

katie_cs: customer prefers changing min_replicas; requesting our assistance. They can't change infra settings themselves.

ryan_eng-runtime: I'll patch the autoscaler policy for that pool to reduce the attach veto sensitivity and bump min_replicas to 5 as an interim. Patch commands: 
```bash
# internal-only
redwoodctl pools update dedicated-pool-14 --min-replicas=5
redwoodctl autoscaler set-policy --pool=dedicated-pool-14 --attach-throttle-threshold=0.8
```
I'll run in 5 minutes and monitor.

alex_support: customer updated the ticket to say they're okay with temporary bump. Please keep us posted so we can update their SLA note.

ryan_eng-runtime: done — scaled min_replicas=5 and loosened veto. Watch logs for imagepull failures. If registry 429s persist, we should coordinate with platform to rotate/paginate registry credentials or ask customer to use a mirror.

samir_ops-bot: action summary recorded: escalated->eng-runtime, min_replicas bumped to 5, autoscaler veto relaxed. Incident ID INC-2026-3311122334.

jessica_relay: after the change, customer reported latency dropped and 429s stopped within ~90s. They still saw a couple of slow attach events (~18s) but no user-facing 429s. Customer will keep us posted if it recurs. :thumbsup:

maya_oncall: follow-ups for eng-runtime: 1) add better telemetry to distinguish attach failures caused by registry rate limits vs node provisioning, 2) consider a graded veto (allow N concurrent attach delays before blocking scale), 3) document recommended mitigations for customers (registry mirrors, prewarmed).

ryan_eng-runtime: agree on all 3. I'll open a follow-up ticket and include proposed config change PRs.

alex_support: closing loop with customer now. Thanks all. :eyes:
